about.en: Bordrless is a Solana project building a token standard whose transfer hooks return an amount rather than only approving or rejecting a transfer, together with a DEX that calls those hooks on every swap and a launchpad built on the same standard. BORDR is its token, a Solana SPL mint with six decimals at 6Mix12LiHrQFojaQEnfPUC65Qkwd6X4Y5Qg93oFbordr.
